# v2.17-dev Release Notes

## Clearer tier & deployment visibility on partner-program dashboards

Two improvements to the program compliance dashboard (**Programs → your program**) for tiered programs.

### What's new
- **Tier Status now names the achieved specialisations.** Each tier box previously showed only a count (`Specialisations: 2 / 3`). It now also lists **which** specialisations are currently achieved at the selected scope (e.g. *Achieved: Spec A, Spec B*), so you can see at a glance what the tier progress is built on. Shows *none yet* when nothing is achieved.
- **Deployment requirements now appear in the Country, Region, Theatre and Global reports.** These reports previously showed only each specialisation's qualifying requirements and its achieved/not-achieved status. They now include a **Deployment requirements** sub-section under each specialisation, showing required vs attained and met/not-met.
  - A specialisation is still **achieved on its qualifying requirements alone** — the deployment requirements don't change that. But because a **tier** that uses the specialisation needs the specialisation *plus* its deployment requirements, they're now visible in these reports (clearly labelled and not "optional").
  - In the Global (per-theatre) view each specialisation card also gets a **Deployment: Met / Not met** badge alongside its compliance badge.
- **Exports include the new detail.** The report exports (CSV/Excel/PDF) gain a **Purpose** column (`Qualification` / `Deployment`) and now include the deployment requirement rows.

### Notes
- Programs that aren't tiered — or tiered programs using **flat** deployment mode (where deployment requirements belong to the tier rather than a specialisation) — are unaffected: no deployment sub-section appears.
- Display-only change: how specialisation achievement and tier compliance are calculated is unchanged.

No action needed after updating.
